_rule: Prepared BEFORE any run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. Measurement batch: no rendering change, no quality claim.
question: The user reports a large frame-rate loss in real play (Ultra, FG 3x, RTX Hair On, distant detail 1/4, rt_hair_mv_card=2, rr_hair_strand_aa=2, sometimes DLSS 5 NR). The 2026-11-14 release profile shows the base passes are not slower than on 2026-11-05 except scene build. Which part of the user's configuration costs the frames, and is it GPU pass time or time outside the GPU timers (CPU hooks, scene wait, pacing)?

reference.note: Those runs were unfocused (30 fps cap), FG 2x, fps_cap 58, dev=0, stock hair. Frame time there is the cap, not the cost.

perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.windows: off-a, on, lod, not, groomrt, off-b: 360 frames each after a same-state settle phase and an acknowledged stats reset; 120-frame producer periods (2-3 complete lines per window).
perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.noise_floor: |off-b - off-a| per metric, same run. A delta below it is not a finding.

on_minus_off.gpu: strand G-buffer draws 0.3-0.6 ms/frame (hl1 200821 at S8: 0.28-0.33); hair fibre passes under 0.5 ms each; scene build +0.3 to +0.8 ms (groom BLAS refits, settings.h records +0.57 ms at Dialogue1); rt passes and GI within -1.5 to +1.5 ms (settings.h: strands cheaper than alpha cards at Dialogue1). Sum of GPU passes: +0.5 to +3 ms.
on_minus_off.outside_gpu_timers: If rendered frame time rises by more than the GPU sum (more than about 3 ms beyond it), the loss is CPU side: read [rt] scene wait mean, [watch] submit CPU and [cpu] capture hooks in the same window (suspects 5 and 6: the per-draw mutex in hair_primary_swap, coverage probe redraws, count readbacks).
on_minus_off.fg: displayed/rendered 3.00 in every window; a lower ratio in the on windows is a pacing loss, not a render cost.

perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.lod_minus_on: within the noise floor at S8 (pl1 prediction: +-0.03 ms strand G-buffer); camera BLAS full builds only right after the switch (settle phase). Larger at the inn (more heads) but under 0.5 ms scene build.
perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.not_minus_on: rt passes and GI lower by 0 to 1 ms (no transmittance continuation in shadow and AO rays). Near zero means transmittance is not the cost.
perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.groomrt_minus_off: the groom TLAS in secondary rays alone (suspect 4) plus groom BLAS refits: scene build +0.3 to +0.8 ms, rt passes and GI -1.5 to +1.5 ms; on - groomrt is then the on-screen strand path (suspects 5 and 6).
perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.memory: [mem] guard normal in every window, used under budget; a 'guard low' or any '[vram] guard: refused/headroom' line names suspect 1 (the analyzer lists them).
perf-ab-s8, perf-ab-inn.decision: Rank the suspects by (delta - noise floor) of rendered frame time, then attribute with the GPU and CPU lines. No key is changed by this batch.

perf-ab-wide-split-0, perf-ab-wide-split.design: The checked-in opt-profile-s8 job (the exact state of run 131416) without its pan windows; only rt_capture_wide_split differs (startup key). Two launches: scene build cannot be compared inside one run.
perf-ab-wide-split-0, perf-ab-wide-split.split_1: reproduces 131416: scene build Ultra 1.84 ms, High 1.69 ms (run-to-run noise about 0.3 ms per pass).
perf-ab-wide-split-0, perf-ab-wide-split.split_0: if the split is the cause: scene build Ultra about 1.2 ms, High about 1.3 ms (the 2026-11-05 'after' values), [bvh] copy jobs per period far lower than 131416's 24313-31002, hold pack jobs not lower. If scene build stays within 0.3 ms of split 1, the split is not the cause.
perf-ab-wide-split-0, perf-ab-wide-split.caveat: Two launches: differences under about 0.3 ms are run-to-run noise (AGENTS.md: never compare images across runs; here only log medians of a static view are compared).

perf-ab-dlss5-s8.precondition: The DLSS 5 runtime must already be staged next to the test tree's layer (sl/nvngx_dlssnr.dll); the launcher does that, a queue job does not. Without it the job fails fast on '[dlss5] NR created'.
perf-ab-dlss5-s8.nr_on_minus_off: [dlss5] gpu NR 3 to 8 ms/frame at 3840 x 1600 output (fixture prior only; no live evidence), rendered frame time higher by the same amount; other passes within the noise floor; the off windows print no gpu NR line.

disk: logs only: no traces, bursts or dumps (dump_images=0).
